_doc: Joint limits from the generated (gitignored) public/model/rig.json, committed so the show linter runs without the model. test/show.test.ts asserts they still match rig.json whenever it exists; rebuild the model and update this table together.
_frame_doc: Canonical body frame (show/SPEC.md 'Frame and zeros'): +Z = the base's front (the speaker pod between the '[ ]' brackets), +Y up, and every joint at 0 = the droid's rest as in the park photos. The printable kit is exported in a display pose, so until the model build bakes the rest in, the sim's Rig applies these once: `body_yaw` turns the whole model about +Y (deg), and a joint's `zero_offset` is the angle its part is turned from the kit pose at value 0 (node angle = value + zero_offset). Joint values, ranges and servo centre pulses are unchanged: they were always about the rest (the Maestro script's centre pulses), only the kit geometry was not. Measured 2026-09-30: base pod at -12.0 deg; lower-ring vents (4-fold) at +31.9; logic panels centred at -55.7; RX-24 plate at 0. Rest: a vent and the pod front, poker arm out to the left side, panels front with the throttle arm out to the right side, RX-24 and the head front.
